[/size][/u][/size][/font][/b][center]{NPC Name}_{eventID} like: Leah_event992253 (you could find it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url])
[size=3]{festival token} available: EggF, FlowerDance, Luau, Jellies, Fair, SpiritsEve, Ice, WintherStar
{day} available: days in month like 1, 2, 3... 28 [b]OR [/b]Sunday, Monday... Saturday
[/size]{year} available: 1, 2, 3....[/center]

* if the festival is added by other mod, it should be the whole English name without space and comma-separated

After 1.06 you could use "ContentPackFor": {"UniqueID": "Arborsm.PortraiturePlus"} in manifest.json to make Portraiture find png in that folder now,
the game will traverse all png files in that directory and attempt to add them to the game,the manifest.json looks like this:

[code]﻿{
    "Name": "test",
    "Author": "test",
    "Version": "1.0.0",
    "Description": "A test mod",
    "UniqueID": "blahblah", // it would be the folder name in game
    "ContentPackFor": {
        "UniqueID": "Arborsm.PortraiturePlus"
    },
    "Dependencies": [
        {
            "UniqueID": "Arborsm.PortraiturePlus",
            "IsRequired": true
        }
    ]
}
[/code]
